cases.input: A page uses useEffect + axios + useState for a shared list already managed elsewhere by TanStack Query. Review and propose the smallest correction.
expected: Recognize duplicated server-state ownership
Prefer the existing query cache rather than another effect
Avoid unrelated global-state or component refactors

cases.input: Implement React login state for a Spring BFF/Keycloak application. A teammate suggests storing access_token in localStorage and refreshing it in an interceptor.
expected: Reject browser OAuth token storage/refresh
Use the BFF session/auth-me contract
Preserve CSRF handling for mutations

cases.input: A mutation that creates a payment retries every failure three times. Review it.
expected: Do not blindly retry non-idempotent mutation
Distinguish validation/auth/conflict from transient failure
Require server idempotency before unsafe retries

cases.input: After logout and login as another user, the dashboard briefly shows the previous user's cached data.
expected: Identify principal-scoped cache leak
Clear/remove affected cache on logout/account switch
Do not solve by disabling all caching globally

cases.input: A profile form has 18 fields, each in its own useState, duplicate validation and poor server-error mapping.
expected: Use project form/schema tooling proportionately
Keep backend validation authoritative
Preserve user input and map field/global errors

cases.input: Review a simple accessible component with one local boolean and no server data.
expected: Do not require TanStack Query or global store
Do not invent generic hooks/contexts
Return no blocking finding when correct

cases.input: A route guard hides /admin from non-admin users; backend endpoint currently lacks role authorization.
expected: State route guard is UX not authorization
Require backend authorization
Keep frontend routing fix separate from server security finding

cases.input: A reviewer proposes useMemo/useCallback/React.memo on every component to make the app senior-grade.
expected: Reject blanket memoization
Prioritize measured bottlenecks/network/list size
Preserve simple code without evidence of a problem

cases.input: A component test mocks the custom query hook and asserts internal call counts for a critical profile flow.
expected: Prefer user-visible behavior
Use a network boundary such as MSW where practical
Keep real BFF/OIDC evidence separate from mocked tests

cases.input: React computes tax totals with Number and serializes a business LocalDate through new Date().toISOString().
expected: Reject floating-point authority for financial values
Preserve date-only semantics
Keep authoritative calculation on backend
